title: TutorialCore: Important Systems
summary: Read the TutorialCore signals, states, and failure clues that matter in play.

blocks.title: What To Watch
blocks.body: Cards, hints, flows, tooltips, triggers, guide mode, and mistake coaching work together so help appears close to the thing the player just did.

blocks.title: Player Signals
blocks.body: Watch cards, hints, flows, progress triggers, mistake coaching, guide mode, and whether a card belongs to the addon you are currently using.

blocks.title: Keep It Legible
blocks.body: A TutorialCore system is working when another player could look at the state, understand the next action, and avoid the obvious failure.

blocks.title: State Check
blocks.body: Use the system note to read the current state, then choose one action that answers it.
